question: What is a 'Stock Market Index'?
options: A list of all companies in a country
A statistical measure that tracks the performance of a specific group of stocks
The price of the most expensive stock
A government department that regulates shares
answer: A statistical measure that tracks the performance of a specific group of stocks
hint: यह market के लिए एक 'barometer' के रूप में कार्य करता है।
explanation: एक index stock market के एक हिस्से (section) का प्रतिनिधित्व (represents) करता है और investors को market trends को समझने और अपने portfolios को benchmark करने में मदद करता है।

question: Which index is considered the benchmark for the Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE)?
options: NIFTY 50
SENSEX
BANK NIFTY
NASDAQ
answer: SENSEX
hint: इसमें 30 large, liquid कंपनियाँ शामिल हैं।
explanation: S&P BSE SENSEX भारत का सबसे पुराना stock index है, जिसे पहली बार 1986 में compile किया गया था।

question: Which index is considered the benchmark for the National Stock Exchange (NSE)?
options: SENSEX
NIFTY 50
DOW JONES
FTSE 100
answer: NIFTY 50
hint: यह NSE पर listed top 50 कंपनियों को track करता है।
explanation: NIFTY 50 एक diversified index है जो भारतीय अर्थव्यवस्था (economy) के 13-15 sectors का प्रतिनिधित्व करता है।

question: What is the primary weighting methodology used for NIFTY 50 and SENSEX today?
options: Price-Weighted
Equal-Weighted
Free-float Market Capitalization Weighted
Revenue-Weighted
answer: Free-float Market Capitalization Weighted
hint: केवल public trading के लिए उपलब्ध shares पर विचार किया जाता है।
explanation: यह विधि (method) promoter holdings और government stakes को छोड़कर (excludes), केवल company की equity के निवेश योग्य (investible) हिस्से पर ध्यान केंद्रित करती है।

question: What does 'Free-float' market capitalization exclude?
options: Shares held by retail investors
Shares held by promoters, government, and strategic investors
Shares held by Foreign Institutional Investors
Shares held by Mutual Funds
answer: Shares held by promoters, government, and strategic investors
hint: इसमें केवल market में 'floating' (तैरने वाले) shares शामिल हैं।
explanation: Free-float उन shares को संदर्भित (refers) करता है जो secondary market में आम जनता (general public) द्वारा trading के लिए आसानी से उपलब्ध हैं।

question: In a 'Price-Weighted' index, the index value is primarily influenced by ________.
options: The total profit of the companies
The stock with the highest absolute price per share
The company with the most employees
The dividend yield
answer: The stock with the highest absolute price per share
hint: अमेरिका में DJIA इसका एक प्रसिद्ध (famous) उदाहरण है।
explanation: Price-weighted indices में, Rs. 1000 पर trade करने वाले stock का प्रभाव Rs. 100 पर trade करने वाले stock से 10 गुना अधिक होता है, चाहे company का size कुछ भी हो।

question: What is the 'Base Year' for the SENSEX?
hint: Base value 100 पर set किया गया था।
explanation: SENSEX 30 constituent stocks के relative growth की गणना करने के लिए 1978-79 का अपने base year के रूप में उपयोग करता है।

question: What is the 'Base Value' for the NIFTY 50?
hint: Base date 3 नवंबर 1995 है।
explanation: Movements को track करने के लिए एक बड़े scale को प्रदान करने हेतु NIFTY को 1000 के base value के साथ launch किया गया था।

question: A 'Sectoral Index' tracks ________.
options: The whole market
A specific industry like IT, Banking, or Pharma
Only government companies
Only small-cap stocks
answer: A specific industry like IT, Banking, or Pharma
hint: उदाहरणों में Nifty Bank या BSE Auto शामिल हैं।
explanation: Sectoral indices investors को broad market के मुकाबले अर्थव्यवस्था (economy) के किसी विशिष्ट हिस्से (specific part) के प्रदर्शन (performance) की तुलना (compare) करने में मदद करते हैं।

question: What is 'Index Rebalancing'?
options: Changing the base year every month
The periodic review of index constituents to add or remove stocks
Adjusting the index for inflation
Selling all stocks in the index
answer: The periodic review of index constituents to add or remove stocks
hint: यह सुनिश्चित करता है कि index current market का प्रतिनिधित्व (representative) करता रहे।
explanation: NSE और BSE समय-समय पर (periodically) indices (जैसे, semi-annually) की समीक्षा (review) करते हैं ताकि यह सुनिश्चित हो सके कि केवल सबसे liquid और बड़ी कंपनियों को ही शामिल किया गया है।

question: Which of the following is an 'Impact Cost'?
options: The cost of the index license
The cost of printing index reports
A measure of liquidity reflecting the price markup/markdown for a trade
The tax on index futures
answer: A measure of liquidity reflecting the price markup/markdown for a trade
hint: कम (Lower) impact cost का अर्थ है उच्च (higher) liquidity।
explanation: Impact cost किसी बड़े order के लिए actual execution price और ideal market price के बीच के अंतर (difference) को दर्शाता है।

question: What is a 'Broad Market Index'?
options: An index with only 2 stocks
An index like Nifty 500 that represents a large portion of the total market
An index that only tracks gold
An index for international stocks only
answer: An index like Nifty 500 that represents a large portion of the total market
hint: कई market caps को cover करता है।
explanation: Broad market indices अर्थव्यवस्था (economy) का व्यापक दृश्य (comprehensive view) देने के लिए कंपनियों (Large, Mid, और Small) की एक विस्तृत श्रृंखला (wide range) को track करते हैं।

question: The 'Divisor' in an index calculation is used to ________.
options: Divide the profits among shareholders
Maintain index continuity during corporate actions like splits or bonuses
Calculate the tax
Reduce the index value to zero
answer: Maintain index continuity during corporate actions like splits or bonuses
hint: यह सुनिश्चित करता है कि केवल stock split के कारण index level में उछाल (jump) न आए।
explanation: जब भी constituents के capitalization में ऐसे बदलाव होते हैं जो market-driven नहीं होते, तो divisor को adjust किया जाता है।

question: What is 'Total Returns Index' (TRI)?
options: An index that only shows stock price growth
An index that includes both stock price changes and dividends reinvested
An index for debt instruments only
The total number of trades in a day
answer: An index that includes both stock price changes and dividends reinvested
hint: Mutual funds को इस index के विरुद्ध (against) benchmark करना चाहिए।
explanation: TRI यह मानकर कि dividends को वापस index में डाल दिया गया है, index द्वारा उत्पन्न (generated) real wealth की अधिक सटीक तस्वीर (accurate picture) प्रदान करता है।

question: What is 'Beta' in relation to an index?
options: The speed of the index
The volatility of a stock or portfolio relative to the index
The name of a new index
The number of sectors in an index
answer: The volatility of a stock or portfolio relative to the index
hint: Index का अपना beta 1 होता है।
explanation: Beta मापता है कि benchmark index में प्रत्येक 1% move के लिए कोई stock कितना move करता है।

question: Which of the following is a criterion for a stock to be included in the NIFTY 50?
options: It must be a government-owned company
It must have high liquidity and float-adjusted market cap
It must be over 100 years old
It must not pay any dividends
answer: It must have high liquidity and float-adjusted market cap
hint: Liquidity को impact cost द्वारा मापा जाता है।
explanation: NIFTY 50 में शामिल Stocks free-float market cap के मामले में top कंपनियों में से होने चाहिए और low impact cost के साथ आसानी से tradable होने चाहिए।

question: What is 'Tracking Error' for an index fund?
options: The time it takes to see the index on TV
The difference between the index fund's returns and the actual index returns
A mistake made by the stock exchange
The cost of buying the index
answer: The difference between the index fund's returns and the actual index returns
hint: Expenses, cash holdings और rebalancing lags के कारण होता है।
explanation: आदर्श रूप से (Ideally), एक index fund को index से पूरी तरह से match करना चाहिए, लेकिन real-world कारकों के कारण एक छोटा सा विचलन (deviation) होता है जिसे tracking error के रूप में जाना जाता है।

question: What is a 'Market Cap-Weighted' index?
options: An index where all stocks have equal weight
An index where larger companies (by market value) have more weight
An index where the newest company has the most weight
An index for the cap industry
answer: An index where larger companies (by market value) have more weight
hint: दुनिया भर में सबसे आम (common) प्रकार का index।
explanation: Nifty पर Reliance या HDFC Bank जैसी बड़ी कंपनियों का प्रभाव index में शामिल छोटी कंपनियों की तुलना में अधिक होता है।

question: What is the 'Blue-chip' index of the Indian market?
options: Nifty Next 50
Nifty 50
Nifty Smallcap 100
Nifty Microcap 250
answer: Nifty 50
hint: इसमें सबसे बड़ी और सबसे established कंपनियाँ शामिल हैं।
explanation: Nifty 50 भारत में large-cap stocks के लिए प्रमुख (premier) index है, जिसे अक्सर 'Blue-chip' कंपनियों के रूप में संदर्भित (referred) किया जाता है।

question: What is 'Passive Investing' based on indices?
options: Trying to beat the index
Investing in index funds or ETFs to match the index performance
Only buying stocks when the index is falling
Asking the index manager for tips
answer: Investing in index funds or ETFs to match the index performance
hint: Low-cost और low-turnover रणनीति (strategy)।
explanation: Passive investors market की दक्षता (efficiency) में विश्वास करते हैं और न्यूनतम लागत (minimal cost) पर market return (Beta) अर्जित (earn) करना चाहते हैं।

question: Which organization maintains the NIFTY indices?
options: BSE Indices Ltd
NSE Indices Limited (formerly IISL)
SEBI
RBI
answer: NSE Indices Limited (formerly IISL)
hint: National Stock Exchange की एक subsidiary।
explanation: NSE Indices Limited Nifty 50, Nifty Bank, और thematic indices सहित indices के एक बड़े suite का प्रबंधन (manages) करता है।

question: What is an 'Equal-Weighted Index'?
options: An index where only large companies are included
An index where every stock, regardless of size, has the same percentage weight
An index for weights and measures
An index that changes weight every hour
answer: An index where every stock, regardless of size, has the same percentage weight
hint: Giant कंपनियों के प्रभुत्व (dominance) को कम करता है।
explanation: एक equal-weighted Nifty 50 में, 50 stocks में से प्रत्येक का weightage ठीक 2% होगा।

question: Which of the following is a 'Thematic' index?
options: Nifty 50
Nifty ESG (Environmental, Social, and Governance)
Sensex
Nifty 500
answer: Nifty ESG (Environmental, Social, and Governance)
hint: एक विशिष्ट (specific) 'theme' या मानदंडों (criteria) पर आधारित।
explanation: Thematic indices स्थिरता (sustainability), उपभोग (consumption), या बुनियादी ढांचे (infrastructure) जैसे विशिष्ट आख्यानों (specific narratives) के आधार पर stocks को group करते हैं।

question: What is the main advantage of using an 'Index' as a benchmark?
options: It guarantees profit
It provides a standardized objective for performance comparison
It tells the future stock prices
It reduces taxes
answer: It provides a standardized objective for performance comparison
hint: 'Alpha' को मापने में मदद करता है।
explanation: Benchmarks investors को यह देखने में मदद करते हैं कि क्या उनका professional manager वास्तव में stocks के एक सरल, unmanaged basket से बेहतर प्रदर्शन (performing better) कर रहा है।

question: Which of the following describes 'Nifty Next 50'?
options: The 50 smallest companies on NSE
The companies ranked 51-100 by market capitalization on NSE
The companies that will be in Nifty 50 next year only
International stocks only
answer: The companies ranked 51-100 by market capitalization on NSE
hint: अक्सर Nifty 50 के लिए 'waiting room' के रूप में देखा जाता है।
explanation: Nifty Next 50 बड़ी कंपनियों के अगले स्तर (next tier) का प्रतिनिधित्व (represents) करता है जो अंततः (eventually) मुख्य Nifty 50 index में प्रवेश (enter) कर सकती हैं।

question: What is 'Volatility Index' (VIX)?
options: An index that tracks only rising stocks
An index that measures market expectation of near-term volatility (Fear Index)
The total volume of the market
An index for tech companies only
answer: An index that measures market expectation of near-term volatility (Fear Index)
hint: India VIX की गणना NSE द्वारा की जाती है।
explanation: VIX market की risk धारणा (perception) को इंगित (indicates) करता है; एक high VIX आमतौर पर अनिश्चितता (uncertainty) और आगे sharp price swings का सुझाव देता है।

question: In index construction, 'Liquidity' is usually measured by ________.
options: The number of employees
The average daily turnover or impact cost
The age of the company
The dividend paid per share
answer: The average daily turnover or impact cost
hint: Stock को कितनी आसानी से trade किया जा सकता है।
explanation: Liquidity यह सुनिश्चित करती है कि funds द्वारा भारी price distortions के बिना index को replicate किया जा सके।

question: What is a 'Fixed Income Index'?
options: An index that never changes
An index that tracks the performance of bonds and debt instruments
An index for fixed assets like buildings
The interest rate on a savings account
answer: An index that tracks the performance of bonds and debt instruments
hint: Market के 'Debt' पक्ष (side) को track करता है।
explanation: उदाहरणों में Nifty 10-year Benchmark G-Sec Index शामिल है।

question: What is 'Survivor Bias' in indices?
options: The tendency for indices to look better because poorly performing companies are removed
The risk of the index disappearing
Buying stocks that have crashed
The index staying open during a war
answer: The tendency for indices to look better because poorly performing companies are removed
hint: Indices केवल विजेताओं (winners) को रखते हैं।
explanation: क्योंकि विफल (failing) कंपनियों को index से हटा दिया जाता है, long-term chart अक्सर average stock अनुभव की तुलना में अधिक सकारात्मक (positive) दिखता है।

question: What is 'Market Depth' in relation to index stocks?
options: The depth of the ocean
The ability of a stock to absorb large buy/sell orders without significant price changes
The number of sectors in the index
The time it takes to compute the index
answer: The ability of a stock to absorb large buy/sell orders without significant price changes
hint: Higher depth का अर्थ है बेहतर liquidity।
explanation: Index stocks को high depth की आवश्यकता होती है ताकि mutual funds और ETFs बड़ी मात्रा में inflows और outflows को कुशलतापूर्वक (efficiently) manage कर सकें।

question: The 'Sector Weighting' in Nifty 50 is dominated by which sector (as of 2024)?
options: Agriculture
Financial Services (Banking/Insurance)
Information Technology
Consumer Goods
answer: Financial Services (Banking/Insurance)
hint: HDFC Bank और ICICI Bank जैसे दिग्गज (giants) शामिल हैं।
explanation: Financial services sector में आमतौर पर broad Indian market indices में सबसे अधिक weightage होता है।

question: What is a 'Custom Index'?
options: An index you make at home
An index designed specifically for a particular investor or fund manager's strategy
An index for luxury goods
An index that is not regulated
answer: An index designed specifically for a particular investor or fund manager's strategy
hint: Bespoke index निर्माण (creation)।
explanation: Institutions कभी-कभी विशिष्ट खंडों (specific segments) को track करने के लिए custom indices का अनुरोध (request) करते हैं जो standard benchmarks द्वारा cover नहीं किए जाते हैं।

question: The 'Full Market Cap' of a company is ________.
options: Total shares multiplied by current price
Free-float shares multiplied by price
Total assets of the company
Total profit of the company
answer: Total shares multiplied by current price
hint: Promoter और government holdings शामिल हैं।
explanation: Full market cap company के कुल सैद्धांतिक मूल्य (total theoretical value) का प्रतिनिधित्व (represents) करता है, जबकि free-float market cap tradable value का प्रतिनिधित्व करता है।

question: What happens to the 'Divisor' when a new stock is added to the index to replace an old one?
options: It is doubled
It is adjusted to ensure the index value does not change solely due to the substitution
It is set to zero
It is ignored
answer: It is adjusted to ensure the index value does not change solely due to the substitution
hint: यह सुनिश्चित करता है कि index 'level' continuous रहे।
explanation: Divisor प्रशासनिक परिवर्तनों (administrative changes) के कारण index level में कृत्रिम उछाल (artificial jumps) को रोकता है।

question: Which of the following describes 'Strategic Indices' (Smart Beta)?
options: Indices that track the market normally
Indices that use factors like Value, Quality, or Low Volatility to select stocks
Indices for strategic military equipment
Indices for chess players
answer: Indices that use factors like Value, Quality, or Low Volatility to select stocks
hint: Active और passive styles का मिश्रण (mix)।
explanation: Smart Beta indices व्यवस्थित, नियमों पर आधारित रणनीतियों (systematic, rules-based strategies) का पालन करके traditional market-cap-weighted indices से बेहतर प्रदर्शन (outperform) करने का लक्ष्य रखते हैं।

question: What is a 'Global Index'?
options: An index for local shops
An index like MSCI World that tracks stocks across multiple countries
An index for space companies
The price of the world's currency
answer: An index like MSCI World that tracks stocks across multiple countries
hint: International diversification benchmarking के लिए उपयोग किया जाता है।
explanation: Global indices investors को यह देखने की अनुमति देते हैं कि विभिन्न देशों के बाजार (country markets) एक-दूसरे के सापेक्ष (relative) कैसा प्रदर्शन कर रहे हैं।

question: What is the 'Price-to-Earnings' (P/E) of an index?
options: The P/E of the most expensive stock in the index
The weighted average P/E of all constituent stocks
The stock price divided by the number of stocks
A fixed number set by SEBI
answer: The weighted average P/E of all constituent stocks
hint: इंगित (Indicates) करता है कि क्या समग्र बाजार (overall market) 'expensive' है या 'cheap'।
explanation: Index P/E एक प्रमुख valuation metric है जिसका उपयोग पूरे market के आकर्षण (attractiveness) का आकलन (judge) करने के लिए किया जाता है।

question: Which index tracks the 'Mid-Cap' segment in India?
options: Nifty 50
Nifty Midcap 100
BSE Smallcap
Nifty Next 50
answer: Nifty Midcap 100
hint: कंपनियों के मध्य स्तर (middle tier) (101-250 rank) पर केंद्रित है।
explanation: Nifty Midcap 100 मध्यम आकार (mid-sized) की कंपनियों के प्रदर्शन (performance) के लिए प्राथमिक मापक (primary gauge) है।

question: What is the 'Dividend Yield' of an index?
options: The total profit of the index
The weighted average dividend yield of all constituent stocks
The number of companies paying dividends
The tax on dividends
answer: The weighted average dividend yield of all constituent stocks
hint: Market की income-generating capacity को दर्शाता है।
explanation: High index dividend yields अक्सर संकेत देते हैं कि market undervalued है।

question: The NIFTY 50 covers approximately ________ sectors of the economy.
hint: व्यापक क्षेत्रीय विविधीकरण (broad sectoral diversification) सुनिश्चित करता है।
explanation: Index design इसे केवल एक या दो industries के अधिक प्रभुत्व (overly dominated) होने से रोकता है।

question: What is 'Momentum' index?
options: An index that tracks slow stocks
An index that tracks stocks with strong recent upward price movements
The speed of the trading terminal
An index for physics companies
answer: An index that tracks stocks with strong recent upward price movements
hint: यह दांव (Betting) लगाना कि 'जो ऊपर जा रहा है वह ऊपर ही जाता रहेगा'।
explanation: Momentum indices पिछले 6-12 महीनों में उनके प्रदर्शन के आधार पर stocks का चयन (select) करते हैं।

question: What is 'Index Licensing'?
options: A driver's license for traders
A fee paid by AMCs to index providers (like NSE Indices) to launch index funds/ETFs
The permission to buy stocks
The registration of the stock exchange
answer: A fee paid by AMCs to index providers (like NSE Indices) to launch index funds/ETFs
hint: Index providers पैसे कैसे बनाते हैं।
explanation: Mutual fund houses को अपने उत्पादों (products) के लिए 'Nifty' या 'Sensex' नाम का उपयोग करने के लिए एक royalty या license fee का भुगतान करना पड़ता है।

question: Which of the following is a 'Large-Midcap' index?
options: Nifty 50
Nifty LargeMidcap 250
BSE 30
Nifty 100
answer: Nifty LargeMidcap 250
hint: Top 100 (large) और अगले 150 (mid) stocks को मिलाता है (Combines)।
explanation: यह index सबसे स्थिर (most stable) और तेजी से बढ़ने वाले large/mid segments में एक संतुलित जोखिम (balanced exposure) प्रदान करता है।

question: What is 'Base Date'?
options: The day the company was born
The date on which the base value of the index is established
The last day of the financial year
The day the market opens
answer: The date on which the base value of the index is established
hint: Nifty के लिए, यह 3 नवंबर 1995 है।
explanation: Base date समय के साथ index के विकास (growth) की गणना (calculating) करने के लिए starting point प्रदान करती है।

question: What is an 'Index Option'?
options: A choice to not look at the index
A derivative contract where the underlying is a stock index like Nifty
The right to change the stocks in the index
A type of savings bond
answer: A derivative contract where the underlying is a stock index like Nifty
hint: पूरे market पर hedging या speculating के लिए उपयोग किया जाता है।
explanation: Nifty और Bank Nifty options दुनिया में सबसे सक्रिय रूप से (actively) trade किए जाने वाले derivative instruments में से हैं।

question: What does a 'Rising Index' generally indicate?
options: Market crash
Overall positive investor sentiment and economic growth
The exchange is closing
Taxes are going to fall
answer: Overall positive investor sentiment and economic growth
hint: Bullish market indicator।
explanation: एक rising index का अर्थ है कि बहुसंख्यक (majority) या सबसे बड़े constituent stocks की market prices बढ़ रही हैं।

question: Which of the following is NOT a benefit of an index?
options: Measuring market performance
Benchmark for funds
Guaranteeing a 10% annual return
Basis for derivative products
answer: Guaranteeing a 10% annual return
hint: Indices market risk का प्रतिनिधित्व (represent) करते हैं, जिसमें अनिश्चितता (uncertainty) शामिल है।
explanation: हालांकि indices market को track करने और trade करने में मदद करते हैं, लेकिन वे returns की गारंटी नहीं दे सकते।

question: What is 'Free-float' percentage?
options: The total number of stocks in the world
The percentage of a company's total shares that are available for trading in the market
The number of shares given as a bonus
The percentage of stocks that are falling
answer: The percentage of a company's total shares that are available for trading in the market
hint: (Total Shares - Locked-in Shares) / Total Shares के रूप में गणना (Calculated) की जाती है।
explanation: एक high free-float percentage आमतौर पर stock के लिए बेहतर liquidity का संकेत देता है।

question: What is 'Basket Trading'?
options: Trading baskets in a market
Buying or selling all the stocks in an index in one single transaction
Buying only one sector
Trading only on holidays
answer: Buying or selling all the stocks in an index in one single transaction
hint: Institutional investors और index funds द्वारा उपयोग किया जाता है।
explanation: Basket trading एक investor को index को तुरंत replicate करने या उसमें अपनी position को adjust करने की अनुमति देता है।

question: Which index is considered a 'Safe Haven' during market volatility?
options: Nifty Bank
Nifty India Consumption
Nifty Gold Index (or similar commodity tracking)
Nifty Smallcap
answer: Nifty Gold Index (or similar commodity tracking)
hint: Commodities अक्सर equity crashes के खिलाफ बचाव (hedge) के रूप में कार्य करते हैं।
explanation: Gold indices अक्सर तब अच्छा प्रदर्शन करते हैं जब investors stocks जैसी जोखिम भरी संपत्तियों (risky assets) से दूर भागते हैं।
